name: Taberna Puertalsol
lede: High above Plaza Puerta del Sol, a rooftop restaurant looks out over the heart of Madrid. A Bromic trade listing names white 6000 W Tungsten Electric heaters, chosen to suit its clean look and spread warmth across the seating.
beats: A rooftop restaurant over Madrid’s best-known square, linked in the listing to a well-known television chef.
The heaters had to suit the restaurant’s clean look and warm the whole seating area.
White 6000 W Tungsten Smart-Heat Electric heaters, according to the listing. One snippet of the same listing also mentions Platinum Gas: electric alone, or both, is to confirm.
